text:
alyssa: Heads-up: running three 30min customer sessions next week to validate our observability MVP (dashboards, trace hooks, per-route cost, error analytics). Need a tight demo + a short poll to prioritize items for launch. Who can help prep?
ken: I can do slides + short demo. Suggest 10min demo, 10min poll, 10min Q&A.
dario: Customers keep asking for token/model-level breakdowns. We should show a mock per-model cost card and call out limits (approx accuracy, sampling caveats).
maria: Also flag compliance ask: an immutable list of error fingerprints with exportable hashes for audits. That will be a gating item for some enterprise customers.
julian: For tracing hooks: customers want quick jump links from a trace to the user's console session and to the corresponding logs. We can prototype a 'jump-to-session' link in the demo.
infra-bot: Sessions scheduled: med-sys (Mon 9:30), ledgerly (Wed 15:00), growthloop (Thu 10:00).
alyssa: Draft poll options: 1) Dashboard templates (cost, latency, errors) 2) Trace->session linking 3) Immutable error fingerprint export 4) Per-model/per-route cost breakdown 5) Sampling controls in UI (indicator vs toggle). Vote weight will be customer impact.
ken: Ops concern: shipping sampling toggles as full write-path in MVP is risky. Recommend shipping a read-only indicator + an admin-only toggle behind a feature flag as stretch.
dario: Agreed. In chat with customers, the main value is visibility. Control can come later.
qa-bot: QA: need a harness to replay traces and emulate cost spikes for acceptance tests. Can create lightweight fixtures to simulate token-cost anomalies.
alyssa: Acceptance/gating suggestions: - Visibility: Dashboard templates render with real data (no placeholders). - Trace links: trace->session link navigates to live session context. - Cost: per-route/model card within ±10% of batch-estimated cost for demo dataset. - Errors: fingerprint list is immutable and exportable as CSV/JSON. - Stability: no >1% increase in 95p latency when observability hooks enabled under synthetic load.
julian: Example gate check for rollout doc: ```# gate: error-surge-rollback if avg_error_rate_window(5m) > baseline*2 and p95_latency_increase > 0.01:
    initiate_fallback(rollback_model_variant)
```
ken: I'll draft a one-pager (MVP scope, gating metrics, rollback playbook) by EOD Friday. Will include BLEEDING-EDGE notes for feature flags and rollout recipe.
maria: For the error fingerprints export, let's include a checksum field (sha256) and a created_at to satisfy audits.
infra-bot: Note: enabling trace hooks for demo customers will require temporary quota bump. Submit infra request ticket: https://infra.redwood/tickets/OBS-1902
dario: For the per-model cost card, show both "estimated token cost" and "amortized infra share" so customers see where dollars go.
alyssa: Action items: Ken one-pager, Ken+Julian demo prototype, QA harness (qa-bot), infra ticket (dario), poll posted to customers. I'll collate customer votes and surface top-2 asks to engineering for scope cut. Posting poll now: https://pulse.redwood.sh/obs-mvp-poll
ken: Quick note for the one-pager: include sample SLO thresholds and an A/B rollback plan (canary %, monitor windows).
qa-bot: I'll draft basic fixtures and a runbook for the synthetic spike tests.
alyssa: Great. Thanks everyone! We'll reconvene after the roadshow with consolidated asks and an updated launch checklist. :party_parrot:
